metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: JavaScript Execution via eval or document.write
properties.description: Detects unsafe JavaScript patterns including eval(), document.write(), and innerHTML with untrusted input
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "javascript" or Message contains "execution" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG08-002
